name: THOMAS CHACRA
tagline: Environmental bioengineer, management systems and audit documentation
addressee: To the QHSE recruitment team, DEME Group, Zwijndrecht.
subject: Application: QHSE Engineer Trainee (R0003875), Thomas Chacra
paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the QHSE Engineer Traineeship at DEME. What distinguishes your programme is that safety and environmental protection are taught as a single discipline rather than as two separate functions. Both ultimately depend on whether documented procedures correspond to what happens on site, and on whether that correspondence is verified. My professional experience has so far concentrated on the environmental side of that question, and I would now like to develop the safety side with equal rigour.

My background is in management systems and environmental data. I have worked through the requirements of ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 during gap analyses against company practice. I have also built the environmental indicators and monitoring KPIs used within those systems. In addition, I created a Power Automate workflow that digitalised a document audit trail, which improved both traceability and retrieval, and I have carried out data quality control and validation, which is essential groundwork when an auditor requests the source of a figure.

I should be straightforward about the limits of my experience. I have not conducted a risk assessment on a vessel, investigated an incident, or worked a rotation offshore. These are substantive gaps for a QHSE position, and they are the primary reason I am applying for a traineeship rather than a coordinator role. What I offer is a candidate who reads standards confidently, who is comfortable in an audit environment, and who is prepared to travel and work in rotation. My English is C1 and my French is native; I have no Dutch at present and would begin studying it.
Thank you for considering my application. I would be glad to discuss the rotations and the expectations of the role in more detail.
